messages:
Maya P.: Hey folks — rolling out a short microtraining + verification sprint for the handbook appendix on benefits eligibility. Goal: get manager sign-offs on edge cases and confirm open enrollment data by EOD next Friday. :calendar:
Alex R.: Quick q — is this the same content as the open-enrollment refresh from last quarter or a separate appendix?
Maya P.: separate appendix. It clarifies eligibility rules for contractors, permanent part-timers, and international hires. Link: https://redwood.intranet/handbook/appendix-benefits (draft).
Jon K.: Thx — will share with hiring managers. Do we need them to upload docs somewhere?
Maya P.: Yes — managers should verify the employee row in the verification sheet and mark a column "manager_verified" = yes. Spreadsheet: https://sheets.redwood.internal/benefits-verification-2026
Sasha L.: Can people who are outside US mark exceptions? Some APAC hires still on legacy plans.
Maya P.: For APAC/legacy, mark "legacy_plan" and add a short note in the comments column. We'll reconcile in the follow-up sync.
Emily T.: Can ppl ops export current enrollment CSV for managers? Makes bulk check easier.
People Ops Bot: Export ready. Run the following in the infra tool to fetch the latest export:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $HR_API_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/hr/enrollments?format=csv -o enrollments_3091122334.csv
```
Alex R.: Nice. I'll run it and attach to the sheet. ETA today afternoon. :white_check_mark:
Jon K.: Timeline check — managers have 7 business days after file posted to verify?
Maya P.: 7 business days is correct. If no verification, team will be auto-enrolled per default rules and escalate to HR for follow-up.
Sasha L.: Can we get a one-pager for managers summarizing common edge cases?
Maya P.: Yes — drafting now. Will ping when ready. Expect short checklist + examples.
Emily T.: How do we track microtraining completion? We added a microlearning module in LMS last week.
Maya P.: LMS module name: "Benefits Appendix — Eligibility clarifier (10 min)". Managers should confirm their direct reports completed it in the sheet; LMS will also emit completion logs to the tracking webhook.
People Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled: channel reminder set for 3091122390 to nudge managers who haven't completed verification.
Alex R.: I'll remind my managers in team channels too.
Maya P.: Thanks — action items summary: (1) Alex/Jon/Sasha: run export + attach CSV; (2) managers: review sheet + mark manager_verified within 7 business days; (3) everyone: complete LMS microtraining (10 min); (4) People Ops: circulate final one-pager and reconcile legacy_plan cases. I'll post follow-up checklist and a short call for any ambiguous cases. :thumbsup:
Jon K.: If a manager flags a complex exception, should they DM you or create a ticket?
Maya P.: Create a ticket in People Ops queue with tag "benefits-exception" and link the sheet row. That ensures audit trail.
Sasha L.: Got it. Happy to help triage legacy APAC rows.
People Ops Bot: Acknowledged. Ticket template: https://redwood.intranet/ops/tickets/benefits-exception-template
Maya P.: Perfect — thanks team. Will post the finalized appendix doc and one-pager by EOD today. :wave:
